key_features: Modern Pink Dollhouse for Girls Inspired by Family Living: This modern pink dollhouse for girls is inspired by real contemporary homes and features 7 fully designed rooms, including a living room, bedroom, kids room, kitchen, bathroom, balcony, and backyard. With soft pink tones, clean lines, and stylish modern furniture, this large dollhouse for kids creates a warm and realistic home environment where children can simulate daily family life, design their own spaces, and enjoy immersive pretend play experiences

Wooden Dollhouse with 49 PCS Furniture for Fully Customizable Play: This wooden dollhouse with furniture includes 49 pcs of detailed accessories (beds, sofas, tables, and kitchen sets). It functions as a DIY dollhouse kit, allowing kids to freely rearrange and decorate every room. Designed to fit most standard dolls (dolls not included), this highly interactive dollhouse furniture set expands play possibilities with your child’s favorite figures

Toddler-Friendly Pretend Play Dollhouse that Sparks Creativity & Storytelling: This pretend play toy for girls ages 3+ encourages children to create their own stories, role-play family routines, and explore imaginative scenarios. Whether hosting dinner, relaxing at home, or designing ideal interiors, this kids dollhouse supports creativity, storytelling ability, and independent thinking through engaging and open-ended play

Social & Emotional Development with Family-Inspired Spaces: Designed with open shared spaces like a kitchen, dining area, and a spacious backyard, this dollhouse playset promotes cooperative play and social interaction. The family-inspired layout and pet-friendly details help children develop empathy, understand relationships, and build emotional awareness while enjoying meaningful family role play with siblings or friends

Montessori-Inspired Educational Dollhouse – Learn Through Play：This Montessori-inspired dollhouse promotes learning through play by simulating real-life routines such as cooking, organizing, sleeping, and family interaction. Helps improve fine motor skills, logical thinking, spatial awareness, and problem-solving ability. A perfect balance of education and entertainment, ideal for early childhood development

Durable & Perfect Gift for Girls Ages 3+: Measuring 27 x 24 x 12 inches, this wooden dollhouse offers spacious play areas for siblings and friends. Made from high-quality wood with smooth edges and child-safe finishes, it is sturdy, durable, and safe. Comes with assembly instructions, making setup for parents.
